key.name: keyboard-button
key.description: Show a small draggable button that opens and closes the on-screen keyboard, for apps that do not open it on their own (X11 apps, Wine).

key.name: keyboard-button-position
key.description: Position of the button as fractions of the monitor's free area, so it stays in place across rotations.

key.name: rounded-corners
key.description: Mask the four corners of the panel with a black rounded wedge, the way One UI does.

key.name: rounded-corner-radius
key.description: Corner mask radius in physical pixels at the panel's 2560-pixel width.
